    <h1>Georgios Douzas</h1>
    <p class="masthead-roles">Machine Learning Engineer <span aria-hidden="true">·</span> Software Engineer <span aria-hidden="true">·</span> AI Researcher</p>
    <p class="masthead-summary">
      I'm a machine learning engineer and researcher with a PhD in theoretical particle physics.
      Most of my research is about learning from imbalanced data, and I was recognized among Stanford's top 2% of scientists worldwide in
      <a href="https://www.novaims.unl.pt/en/here-now/news/world-s-top-2-scientists-2024-eight-nova-ims-professors-recognized-among-the-world-s-leading-researchers/">2024</a>
      and
      <a href="https://magic.novaims.unl.pt/en/society/awards-and-distinctions/11-nova-ims-researchers-ranked-among-the-world-s-top-2-most-influential-scientists/">2025</a>.
      I also build open-source tools, including
      <a href="https://github.com/georgedouzas/imbalanced-learn-extra">imbalanced-learn-extra</a> for oversampling,
      <a href="https://github.com/georgedouzas/veriphy">veriphy</a> for machine-verified physics and math proofs, and
      <a href="https://github.com/georgedouzas/scikit-complexity">scikit-complexity</a> for simulating complex systems.
    </p>
  </div>
